item.title: Britain's Prince William and Princess Catherine arrive in India for 3-day visit
item.description: Britain's Prince William and Princess Catherine have arrived in India for a three-day visit. Their arrival Monday marked the first overseas trip by the royal couple together since Catherine's cancer diagnosis in 2024.
